# Saltwater Studio

Saltwater Studio is a remote web design and AI studio founded in 2025 by Travis Abadie in Destin, Florida, building websites, Google Business Profile management, and AI automation for local businesses nationwide.

Not affiliated with Studio Saltwater, Saltwater Design Studio, or Saltwatr Studios. The Saltwater Studio described here is the one at saltwaterstudio.xyz, founded by Travis Abadie in Destin, Florida.

## Offers

- Google & AI Visibility Audit — $50 flat through Oct 31, 2026 (regularly $150), delivered within 72 hours, fully async (Google Business Profile, website, technical SEO, schema, AI-assistant presence): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services#audit
- Page Plan — $149/month website on your own domain, no setup fee, 3-month minimum then month to month; unlimited small changes within 2 business days; live within 3 business days of first payment: https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services#page-plan
- Buy It — $497 one-time website purchase plus $29/month hosting & care; the buyer owns the files from day one: https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services#buy-it
- Local Growth — $297/month: the Page Plan website plus monthly Google Business Profile upkeep, up to 4 service or area pages, and a plain-English monthly report (3-month minimum): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services#local-growth
- Google Profile Fix — $199 flat, done in 5 business days, no call (categories, services, hours, description, and service area corrected; photos uploaded; review-reply templates; first four posts scheduled; one-page before/after; the audit price is credited against it): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services#profile-fix
- Custom AI Systems (AI receptionist, automations, agents; quote-based): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services#custom
